work: A. T. Robertson, A Harmony of the Gospels for Students of the Life of Christ, Based on the Broadus Harmony in the Revised Version
firstPublished: New York: George H. Doran Company, 1922 ("Copyright, 1922, by George H. Doran Company"); later printings by Harper & Brothers carry "Copyright, 1922, by Harper & Brothers".
copyrightStatus: Public domain in the United States (published 1922, i.e. before 1929; US works published in 1922 entered the public domain no later than 1998). Robertson died in 1934, so it is also public domain in life+70 and life+80 countries; not necessarily PD in life+95/100 jurisdictions. Gutenberg flags the text as PD in the US.

primarySource.edition: Project Gutenberg eBook #36264 (released 2011-05-29, updated 2021-01-07, produced by Ron Swanson), transcribed from a Harper & Brothers printing
primarySource.part: Analytical Outline of the Harmony (pp. xiii-xxxii)

crossChecks: Table for Finding Any Passage in the Harmony (same Gutenberg text): verse sets agree for every section and gospel.
Section headers in the body of the Harmony (same Gutenberg text): verse sets agree for every section.

archive.org OCR of two independent scans of the 1922 George H. Doran printing: https://archive.org/details/harmonyofgospels00robe (Princeton Theological Seminary Library) and https://archive.org/details/harmonyofgospels00robeuoft (University of Toronto). Outline aligned line by line; body section headers compared per section. All differences were OCR noise or misprints in the printed outline (see note fields), checked against the page images.

Verse existence: every start and end verse exists (KJV/RV versification, from STEPBible TAGNT, checked against a KJV verse-count table). Taken together the sections cover every verse of the four Gospels except Matt. 17:21 and Mark 11:26, which the Revised Version omits (the book notes this).

fields.refs: Compact gospel references (MAT/MRK/LUK/JHN, null when absent). A ";" separates ranges in different chapters; a "," adds verses in the same chapter as the preceding range (e.g. "14:26, 32-42"). Whole chapters are expanded (e.g. "Matt. 24, 25" becomes "24:1-25:46").
fields.ranges: The same references as [startChapter, startVerse, endChapter, endVerse] arrays in printed order. These include otherRefs books (ACT, 1CO).
fields.printedRefs: The reference line exactly as given in the Gutenberg Analytical Outline.
fields.label: The section label: "128a" and "128b" are split sections; every other label is the section number.
fields.subsections: Sections 54 (Sermon on the Mount) and 64 (first group of parables) only.
fields.note: Explains each place where the 1922 printed outline differs from the data, or the order is non-obvious.
